interface.signature: root: TreeNode, target: int, k: int -> list[int]

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: root is either a TreeNode instance or None, representing an empty tree
k is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive
target is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] if node is not None) if root else True
preconditions.description: all node values in the tree are integers between 1 and 10^4 inclusive

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) for node in return_value)
len(return_value) == len({node: True for node in return_value})
all(1 <= node <= 10**4 for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: all nodes in return_value are integers between 1 and 10^4 inclusive
return_value is sorted in ascending order

postconditions.expression: all(node in {n.val for n in tree_nodes(root)} for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: every node in return_value exists in the tree

postconditions.expression: all(distance(root, target, node) == k for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: every node in return_value is exactly at distance k from the target node
